summary: Kerb beside a grassy bank where a motorhome is parked; homes 20-30 m away.
reasons: Motorhome and cars park on this kerb

best_section.where: Top of the Meiers Road north kerb, beside the grassy vacant bank above the bend

drivers.seclusion: Vacant grassed bank behind the kerb; nearest dwellings 20 m (at 15 m) and 30 m, with more homes within 25 m further down.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain sealed kerb, no gate; footpath and grass verge beside, room for a van off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Local through road with moderate traffic; a motorhome sits parked about 35 m along.
drivers.convention: A motorhome and cars park along this kerb; no signs mapped here.

flags: Slope over whole stretch averages 4.4%, but top 25 m is flat
Homes within 25 m on this side
Slopes down steeply from 30 m onwards
sun_shade: Open to sun; a large tree canopy shades the 0-10 m end from the south-east.
